timeline.summary: GRM Overseas launched 10X Basmati Rice Suitable for Diabetics across domestic and international markets.
On 29 April 2026, GRM Overseas received NSE and BSE in-principle approval to list 2,31,54,000 shares issued on warrant conversion (77,18,000 at a ₹148 premium) plus 2:1 bonus shares.
GRM Overseas held an EGM on May 02, 2026, approving the alteration of the MOA object clause and re-appointment of Mrs. Nidhi as an independent director.

On 2 May 2026, GRM Overseas shareholders passed both EGM special resolutions — altering the MOA object clause and re-appointing Mrs. Nidhi as independent director — with over 99.99% of votes polled in favour.

On 13 May 2026, GRM Overseas filed CARE Ratings' monitoring agency report for Q4FY26, showing ₹88.43 Cr of its ₹136.05 Cr warrant proceeds utilised and ₹47.62 Cr unspent, with no deviation from objects.
GRM Overseas receives trading approval for **2,31,54,000** shares from warrant conversion and bonus
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹597.2 Cr, net profit ₹21.61 Cr.
GRM Overseas reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,769.2 Cr and PAT of ₹76.0 Cr.
GRM Overseas reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,806 Cr and PAT of ₹76 Cr, driven by strong domestic branded growth.
ATUL GARG, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on GRM Overseas Limited’s equity shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI Reg. 31(4).
